ask_ai: Ask your AI assistant for help or to perform tasks.
menu: Open the main menu for more options.
help_center: Find answers and how-to guides in our Help Center.
quick_actions_hint: These buttons are shortcuts to your most common daily tasks.
grow_business: Run marketing campaigns and use tools to get more customers.
referrals: Invite friends to OHC and earn rewards for both of you.
email_marketing: Send beautiful emails to your customers to boost sales.
stats: See how your store is doing with simple charts and numbers.
share: Get a link to your store to share on social media or with friends.
add_product: Add a new product or service to your store.
view_orders: View and manage recent orders from your customers.
messages: Check and reply to customer messages from all your channels.
api_docs: Advanced: Connect OHC to custom software if you are a developer.
advisory_hint: Tips and advice from your business helper based on your recent activity.
mark_order_ready: Let your customer know their order is ready for pickup or shipping.
approve_draft: Review and approve what your helper has prepared for you.
billing: Manage your subscription plan and see your recent invoices.
